configuration.existing: Local configuration already exists; no changes were made.
configuration.privacy: Never share these values or the generated files.
configuration.regenerate: To regenerate credentials, back up and remove the local .env and GSI configuration files first.
dashboard.shell.localDraftsExplicitPubli: Local drafts · explicit publication in Studio
experience.appearanceHelp: The controls below preview display preferences without publishing. To save preferences in a profile, open Customization Studio and choose Save and apply.
experience.conflictBody: Keep your draft, review the server version or explicitly confirm replacing it. A timeout means the publication outcome is uncertain. Keep draft and leave waits for local saving without publishing.
experience.demoHelp: Synthetic data. No PIN, no private profiles.
experience.densityHelp: Global spacing: Normal / Compact. Change it in Studio → Properties → Profile.
experience.diagnosticsFailed: Could not request diagnostics. Reconnect to CCS and try again.
experience.disclosure: Personal project developed with substantial help from ChatGPT (OpenAI) for code, interface, tests and documentation. Not affiliated with Valve, Counter-Strike, FACEIT or OpenAI. No independent security certification.
experience.draftPolicy: Local drafts survive a confirmed local save and normal browser closure. Confirmed voluntary logout clears this context’s drafts and pending publication intents.
experience.edition: Personal CS2 dashboard · Match Center / Player Edition
experience.exportFailed: Could not prepare the download. Your profiles are unchanged. Check browser download permissions and try again.
experience.exportPrepared: Download prepared. Check your browser’s downloads; CCS cannot confirm that the file was saved.
experience.firstHelp: Three short steps to prepare CCS. Open them when you need them.
experience.geometryHelp: Position X/Y and width/height in grid cells in the Studio. Responsive display never rewrites the desktop layout.
experience.gsiBody: If GSI is missing, check the generated configuration and restart CS2. A menu signal and recent match data are different. No competitive match is needed to test. The estimated bomb timer remains disabled by default; competitive use may be restricted.
experience.gsiWaiting: GSI received · waiting for match data
experience.intro: A personal CS2 dashboard, built around the information you need.
experience.invalidPin: Incorrect PIN. Check the PIN from your current installation.
experience.liveHelp: The server, GSI reception and match data are separate states. A GSI signal alone does not prove that a match is active.
experience.localPolicy: Studio changes stay in local drafts. Save and apply sends an explicit publication request; success is shown only after server confirmation.
experience.navBody: Full, Compact and Hidden navigation are available. In Hidden mode, use the edge button, optional floating button or Alt+M when the browser permits. Escape closes the revealed menu or exits immersive mode. Fullscreen always has an exit control.
experience.noLive: Demonstration is not a CS2 connection test.
experience.pinBody: Your PIN is created by your installation. Never paste it into a URL or support report. After repeated failures, wait before retrying. A server connection does not imply that CS2 is sending data.
experience.pinHelp: Use the PIN created by your CCS installation. It stays out of URLs and drafts.
experience.privacyBody: Diagnostic export is available only after authentication. Review it before sharing. Never share your PIN, GSI token, raw game packets or personal profiles. Keep CCS local or on an explicitly configured trusted LAN; never open its port to the Internet.
experience.recoveryBody: Stop CCS before offline profile recovery. Keep the original file and a verified private backup. Never delete data/ or replace credentials to fix a profile error. Follow the profile recovery guide shipped with the source.
experience.refused: Connection refused. Access may be temporarily limited after repeated attempts. Wait before retrying; also check the server.
experience.sessionEnded: Session ended. Enter your PIN to connect again.
experience.setup1Body: Start Docker Desktop, then use the CCS Windows installer or your existing launcher. Keep the generated PIN private.
experience.setup2Body: Use the installer to prepare GSI in the game’s cfg folder, then restart CS2. GSI sends allowed game information to CCS; it does not read game memory.
experience.setup3Body: Connect with your PIN, open Dashboard and choose a profile. Try the demonstration first if CS2 is not running. Help and diagnostics remain available in Settings.
experience.shortPin: Enter a PIN with at least six characters.
experience.studioBody: Customization Studio edits a local draft: widgets, variants, X/Y geometry and profile preferences. Keep draft and leave preserves local work; Save and apply publishes it. Each tab keeps its own profile selection.
experience.targetHelp: Published preferences belong to this profile. Change them in Customization Studio, then Save and apply.
experience.themesBody: Choose one of ten complete themes in Studio → Properties → Profile. Save and apply publishes it. Personal widget colors remain overrides.
experience.unavailable: Server unreachable. Check Docker and the local address.
experience.variantHelp: Standard / Compact / Minimal, independently per widget in Studio → Properties.
experience.version: The browser and server versions differ. Restart CCS and reload this page.
installer.backup_missing: Original backup not found. The GSI file is preserved to prevent data loss.
installer.bomb_warning: The bomb countdown is an estimate for training or authorized use. It stays disabled unless you explicitly choose Yes.
installer.denied_admin: The CS2 folder is still not writable even as administrator. Check Windows permissions and the installation path.
installer.disclaimer: Uses official CS2 GSI only; requires Windows and Docker Desktop.
installer.docker_down: Docker Desktop cannot be reached. Open Docker Desktop, then run docker info.
installer.docker_start_failed: Could not start Docker. Check whether the port is already in use.
installer.docker_wait: Server not yet confirmed. Check docker compose logs.
installer.elevation_declined: Administrator permission was declined. No game files were modified.
installer.elevation_failed: Elevated setup did not complete. Check the administrator console output.
installer.elevation_ok: Launching elevated installer. Please respond to the Windows UAC prompt.
installer.elevation_question: Request Windows administrator permission (UAC) to finish installing GSI?
installer.elevation_reason: CS2 config folder is not writable with current permissions.
installer.existing_env: Existing .env found: your credentials are preserved.
installer.fail_note: Do not manually delete an existing configuration. See docs/guides/windows-installation.md.
installer.gsi_absent: The GSI file is already absent. CCS will stop tracking it.
installer.gsi_identical: The identical pre-existing GSI file was preserved.
installer.gsi_not_replaced: The existing GSI file was preserved. Confirm interactively or use -ForceGsiOverwrite deliberately.
installer.gsi_ok: GSI configuration installed. Restart CS2 if the file changed.
installer.gsi_replace: A different GSI file already exists. Back it up and replace it?
installer.invalid_credentials: Missing or invalid credentials in .env. Keep the original file.
installer.lan_not_confirmed: LAN access was not confirmed. Run again without -Lan to keep access local to this PC.
installer.lan_private: I confirm that this network is private and trusted.
installer.network.addressHelp: Use the PC’s local IP address and configured port. Devices must be on the same trusted private network.
installer.network.addressLabel: Other devices on the local network
installer.network.description: Allow other devices on your local network, such as another PC, a tablet or a phone, to access CCS?
installer.network.localOnly: Local mode: access from this PC only.
installer.network.title: Local network access
installer.network.warning: LAN mode exposes unencrypted HTTP. Use only a trusted private network; never forward the port to the Internet. The PIN remains required but does not encrypt traffic. CCS does not automatically open Windows Firewall. Administrator permission and network actions require explicit consent.
installer.new_env: Unique PIN and token generated for this installation.
installer.no_compose: Docker Compose v2 is unavailable. Check docker compose version.
installer.no_docker: Docker was not found. Install and start Docker Desktop.
installer.not_found: CS2 was not found in accessible Steam libraries. Use -Cs2Path to specify its location.
installer.other_cs2: This installation manages another CS2 directory. Uninstall from that location before changing the destination.
installer.path_help: Select the CS2 directory or game\csgo\cfg.
installer.secrets: Never publish .env or a real GSI CFG on GitHub. Do not forward the HTTP port.
installer.settings_failed: Could not apply settings. Check Docker Desktop and the existing image; do not delete .env or data/.
installer.settings_intro: Apply .env settings: the container will restart without rebuilding the image.
installer.settings_ok: Settings applied. Reload the Dashboard. Profiles and credentials are preserved.
installer.stageFolder: Access to the CS2 GSI folder
installer.status_privacy: No PIN or token is displayed or written to diagnostics.
installer.status_unmanaged: GSI installation is not managed by this installer.
installer.uninstall_none: No managed GSI configuration found; nothing to remove.
installer.uninstall_preserve: Your .env, server profiles, local drafts and GSI recovery backups are preserved.
installer.uninstall_unchanged: The existing GSI file was changed after setup and will be preserved.
installer.write_check: Checking write access to the CS2 GSI folder...
maintenance.cancelledSnapshot: Cancelled. Profiles unchanged; the verified snapshot was retained.
maintenance.candidateId: Activation candidate ID: {id}. No activation performed.
maintenance.confirm: Type exactly {expected} to continue, or press Enter to cancel:
maintenance.description: Explicit offline recovery. Stop the server/container before changing profiles.
maintenance.failed: Recovery refused or failed ({code}). Keep all snapshots; inspect the reset state before retrying.
maintenance.help.activate: Explicitly replace verified historical profiles with the prepared target generation.
maintenance.help.initialize: Explicit first-install initialization in an empty data directory only.
maintenance.help.inspect: Read-only format classification; never print profile contents.
maintenance.help.prepareActivation: Verify historical files and prepare a private target candidate; do not activate.
maintenance.help.prepareReset: Create and verify a distinct private snapshot, without resetting.
maintenance.help.reset: Confirm resetting the historical format using a verified snapshot. Explicit target activation is then required for the current runtime.
maintenance.help.restore: Restore a validated current-format .bak; stop the service first.
maintenance.help.restoreActivation: Restore both original profile files after preserving the current state.
maintenance.help.restoreReset: Confirm restoring exact original bytes, possibly incompatible with this version.
maintenance.help.restoreTarget: Restore validated target .bak into a new generation after preserving current bytes.
maintenance.help.revision: Exact 40-character historical application commit retained for rollback.
maintenance.help.stopped: Explicit acknowledgement that the service/container is stopped; not a liveness probe.
maintenance.historicalReset: Historical profiles reset and validated. The verified snapshot and rotating .bak were retained.
maintenance.initializeWarning: Initialize a new target generation only in an empty directory. Existing profiles are never replaced.
maintenance.inspectPolicy: The current runtime requires validated target storage; no inspection performs activation.
maintenance.interrupted: Interrupted. Keep all snapshots and inspect the reset state before retrying.
maintenance.laterPublications: If target publications succeeded, they will not appear in the historical state. Their snapshot is retained.
maintenance.newAttempt: Keep every backup. Prepare a NEW activation ID before another attempt; an old storage generation must not be reused.
maintenance.notReset: No reset performed. Keep the snapshot private; .env and unrelated files were not copied.
maintenance.privatePreserved: The verified private backup remains available. PIN, GSI token, .env and unrelated data stay unchanged.
maintenance.resetWarning: This resets ALL historical profile layouts, names and customizations to a new empty target profile.
maintenance.restored: Profiles restored from a validated backup. The previous current file was preserved when present. Keep all recovery files private.
maintenance.restoredCompatibility: Raw restored bytes may require their original software version. The rotating .bak was not changed.
maintenance.restoreTargetWarning: Restore target backup configuration into a NEW generation. Later publications are not included; old drafts/intents are not adopted.
maintenance.restoreWarning: Restore requires a stopped service and the retained compatible application/image.
maintenance.retainImage: Keep the matching application/image revision available. Credentials and unrelated files were not copied.
maintenance.snapshotReady: A verified private snapshot is available. No other private settings will be reset.
maintenance.stopFirst: stop the service and pass --service-stopped; no files have been changed
maintenance.stopWriters: Stop all old tabs and writers; run only a compatible application after activation.
